device.name: Redmi K80
device.evidence: Read-only runtime Android properties and /sys/firmware/fdt; see PORTING_NOTES.md and BOOT_CHAIN_RESEARCH.md

android_boot_header.evidence: Offline inspection of extracted slot-A boot images; does not describe an XNU image ABI

fastboot_ram_boot.evidence: Must be explicitly tested/verified for this model before any custom image boot

uefi_partition_role.evidence: uefi_a/b existence does not prove role, compatibility, or safe write target

boot_mpidr.evidence: Must be read on the actual boot core by a diagnostic shim; do not infer from Linux CPU numbering

translation_granules.evidence: Read ID_AA64MMFR0_EL1 on each core before selecting XNU page-table assumptions

gicd_base.evidence: Runtime Linux FDT; mapping/access not yet validated from shim/XNU

gicr_base.evidence: Runtime Linux FDT; redistributor affinity/wake state not yet validated

gic_its_base.evidence: Runtime Linux FDT; not needed for first CPU0 milestone

timer_frequency_hz.evidence: Must be measured/read from architectural timer registers; do not reuse topaz's 19.2 MHz

uart_candidate_base.evidence: Runtime FDT candidate only; console=ttynull and physical routing/access unverified

usb_cdc.evidence: Must be implemented and tested for zorn; giulia's USB CDC code is not a board-independent drop-in

memory.evidence: Runtime FDT has multiple RAM banks and reserved-memory/no-map regions. Normalize full 64-bit ranges before enabling an allocator.

mmio_base.evidence: Do not copy topaz's 0x04804000 or giulia's board values; identify zorn controller and sequence from runtime FDT/vendor sources

panel_resolution.evidence: Panel/DSI/MDP details must come from zorn-specific sources and runtime evidence

framebuffer_base.evidence: Do not copy topaz's framebuffer address

safety.policy: Research and static validation only until reversible RAM boot and a verified return-to-stock plan exist.
